summary: Birkenstock Holding plc disclosed an accelerated share repurchase (ASR) agreement with Goldman Sachs International to repurchase $250 million of its ordinary shares. Under the agreement, the company made an upfront payment of $250 million and expects initial delivery of ~6 million shares (80% of the underlying shares) based on a closing price of $33.21 on May 20, 2026. The final share count will be based on a discount to the Rule 10b-18 VWAP during the term. Settlement is expected before June 30, 2026, funded by cash on hand and a revolving credit facility. This ASR signals management's view that the stock is undervalued relative to fundamentals. Watch for completion timing and any additional repurchase activity.
